biz.hint: Your agents and automations, connected to Fyso Biz
cli.usage:
Usage: fyso <command> [instance]

  list [--json]       List your instances and their state
  status [instance]   State of an instance (the current one by default)
  open [instance]     Open its panel in the browser
  switch <instance>   Choose the current instance
  start [instance]    Start the instance's agents and automations
  stop [instance]     Stop the instance
  create              Open the form to create a new instance
  add <folder>        Register an instance created by hand
  biz-login           Sign in to Fyso Biz

An instance is named by its name, its identifier or its folder.
cli.no_instances: No instances yet. Create one with "fyso create".
